about.title: Who We Are
about.intro: Welcome to Tienda Deportiva, your reference in sports equipment. We were born in the classrooms of the University of Alicante with a clear mission: to demonstrate that technology and sports make the perfect team.

history.title: 🏆 Our History
history.text: This project started as an academic challenge in the Web Engineering course. What started with a few lines of code in Java and Vue.js has become a complete e-commerce platform, designed to offer a smooth and modern user experience.

innovation.title: Innovation
innovation.text: We use the latest technologies (Spring Boot 3, Vue 3, Pinia) to build robust software.

learning.title: Learning
learning.text: Every bug is a lesson; every feature, an achievement. We grow with every commit.

teamwork.title: Teamwork
teamwork.text: Backend and Frontend united by a REST API. Collaboration is our key.

team.title: 👨‍💻 The Team
team.text: We are students passionate about software development. We handle the entire tech stack, from the database to the interface you are seeing right now.

cookies.title: Cookies Policy
cookies.intro: At Tienda Deportiva we use our own and third-party cookies to improve the browsing experience, manage your cart content, and allow access to private areas.

what_is.title: 1. What is a cookie?
what_is.text: A cookie is a small text file stored in your browser when you visit almost any webpage. Its utility is for the web to be able to remember your visit when you return to browse that page.

used_cookies.title: 2. Cookies used by this website
used_cookies.intro: Following the guidelines of the Spanish Data Protection Agency, we detail the use of cookies made by this website:

technical.title: 🍪 Technical Cookies (Necessary)
technical.text: These are essential for the functioning of the website. In our case, we use them to:

list.cart: Remember products you have added to the cart.

analysis.title: 📊 Analysis Cookies
analysis.text: Being an academic project, we do not use real tracking tools like Google Analytics, although in a real production environment, they would be used to quantify the number of users and perform measurement and statistical analysis.

deactivation.title: 3. Deactivation or elimination
deactivation.text: At any time you can exercise your right to deactivate or eliminate cookies from this website. These actions are performed differently depending on the browser you are using (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, etc.).

notes.title: 4. Additional notes
notes.text: This website is an academic project. No navigation data is collected for commercial or advertising purposes.

help.title: Help & FAQ
help.intro: Do you have questions? Here we resolve the most common queries from our customers.

shipping.question: 📦 How long will my order take to arrive?
shipping.answer: Mainland shipments usually take between 24 and 48 business hours. For islands, the period is 3-5 days.

returns.question: 🔄 How can I return a product?
returns.answer: You have 30 days for returns. Go to your profile, go to "My Orders" and select the "Request Return" option. We will send you a prepaid label.

password.question: 🔑 I forgot my password, what do I do?
password.answer: On the Login screen, click on "Forgot your password?". You will receive an email to reset it securely.

invoice.question: 🧾 Will I receive an invoice for my purchase?
invoice.answer: Yes, you will automatically receive an email with the simplified invoice. You can also download it from your client area.

contact.title: Need more help?
contact.text: Our support team is available for you.

download.title: 📥 Invoice Download
download.text: You can access all your invoices from your Client Area. Once inside, go to the 'My Orders' section, where you will find the PDF download icon next to each completed purchase.

business.title: 🏢 Invoices for Companies
business.text1: If you need a full invoice in the name of your company or as a freelancer, make sure to fill in the tax details (Tax ID/VAT, Business Name, and Fiscal Address) in your profile before placing the order.
business.text2: If you forgot to do so, you can request the modification by contacting support within 7 days of purchase.

taxes.title: 📊 Taxes (VAT)
taxes.text: All prices shown on our website include VAT applicable in Spain (21% standard rate). In the order summary and final invoice, you will see the detailed breakdown of the taxable base and the tax amount.

legal.title: Legal Notice
legal.intro: In compliance with Article 10 of Law 34/2002, of July 11, on Information Society Services and Electronic Commerce (LSSICE), the identifying data of the entity are set out below:

items.address: Registered Office: Carretera de San Vicente del Raspeig s/n, 03690 San Vicente del Raspeig, Alicante (University of Alicante)
items.activity: Activity: Teaching practice of the Web Engineering subject.

object.title: 2. Object of the website
object.text: This website has been created for purely educational purposes to demonstrate Full Stack web development skills (Vue.js + Spring Boot). No product offered is real and no actual charge will be made.

intellectual_property.title: 3. Intellectual Property
intellectual_property.text: The source code, graphic designs, images, photographs, sounds, animations, software, texts, as well as the information and contents collected on this website are protected by Spanish legislation on intellectual and industrial property rights in favor of the project authors.

responsibility.title: 4. Exclusion of guarantees and responsibility
responsibility.text: The authors are not responsible, in any case, for damages of any nature that may cause, by way of example: errors or omissions in the content, lack of availability of the portal or the transmission of viruses or malicious programs, despite having adopted all the necessary technological measures to prevent it.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: At Tienda Deportiva we are committed to protecting the privacy and security of your personal data. This policy describes how we collect, use, and protect your information.

controller.title: 1. Data Controller
controller.text: Any personal data that may be collected directly from the interested party will be treated confidentially and will be incorporated into the corresponding processing activity owned by the student developers of this sports shop project.

purpose.title: 2. Purpose of processing
purpose.intro: We process the information provided by interested persons in order to:

list.register: Manage user registration on the platform.
list.orders: Process simulated orders and manage the shopping cart.

legitimation.title: 3. Legitimation
legitimation.text: The legal basis for the processing of your data is the consent of the interested party when voluntarily registering on our academic platform.

rights.title: 4. User Rights
rights.intro: Anyone has the right to obtain confirmation as to whether or not we are processing personal data concerning them. Interested persons have the right to:

list.limitation: Request the limitation of its processing.

shipping.title: 1. Shipping Policy
shipping.text: Since this is an academic project, no actual physical shipments are made. The times shown on the web are simulations to recreate the user experience.

withdrawal.title: 2. Right of Withdrawal
withdrawal.text1: In accordance with current regulations, the client would have (in a real environment) the right to withdraw from their purchase within a period of 14 calendar days without need for justification.
withdrawal.text2: The withdrawal period will expire 14 calendar days from the day you or a third party indicated by you, other than the carrier, acquired material possession of the goods.

warranty.title: 3. Product Warranty
warranty.text: In case of a defective product, the seller must proceed, as appropriate, to the repair, replacement, price reduction, or termination of the contract, steps that will be free for the consumer and user. The seller is liable for any lack of conformity that becomes apparent within a period of three years from delivery.

procedure.title: 4. Return Procedure
procedure.text: To exercise your right of return, you should contact our customer service through the email returns@tiendadeportiva.test providing the order number and the reason for the return (optional).

secure_purchase.title: Secure Purchase
secure_purchase.intro: Your security is our priority. We have implemented the highest protection standards so you can shop with total peace of mind.

ssl.title: 🔒 SSL Security
ssl.text: All navigation on our website is protected via HTTPS protocol with 256-bit SSL encryption. This ensures that your data travels encrypted and is inaccessible to third parties.

methods.title: 💳 Payment Methods
methods.text: We accept payment via a payment gateway:

list.card: Credit/Debit Card: Processed through a secure banking gateway.

protection.title: 🛡️ Data Protection
protection.text: We strictly comply with GDPR. Your banking data is never stored on our servers; it is sent directly to the financial institution through secure channels.

stores.intro: Although our soul is digital, you can find us in the heart of the university campus.
